name: combobox
title: Combobox
description: Picks one or more values from a long list by typing to filter it, then Apply.

props.name: options
props.description: Options, or titled groups of options.

props.name: value
props.description: The applied picks.

props.name: footer
props.description: Cancel and Apply under the list; picks apply only with Apply.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown while nothing is picked. Defaults to the `select` label ("Select…").

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.description: The query field's placeholder and name. Defaults to the `search` label.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Shown when nothing matches the query. Defaults to the `noResults` label.

props.name: filter
props.description: How typing narrows the list: by label and description (`true`), by your own test, or not at all (`false`), when the app searches and passes the results as `options`.

props.name: onQueryChange
props.description: The query as it's typed, and '' when the list opens again: for searching on the app's side.

props.name: loading
props.description: The app is searching: a Spinner in place of the search icon, `aria-busy` on the list.

props.name: loadingText
props.description: Shown in place of `emptyText` while `loading` and nothing is listed. Defaults to the `loading` label.

props.name: selectedOptions
props.description: The picks as options, for picks `options` doesn't hold right now (search results change with the query). The field takes a pick's label and icon from here first.

props.name: renderOption
props.description: Draws a row's content in place of the default label, description, icon and check.

props.name: renderValue
props.type: (picked: SelectOption[], api: { remove: (value: string) => void; disabled: boolean }) => React.ReactNode
props.description: Draws the picks in the field in place of the chips (`multiple`) or the picked label. `remove` drops one pick.

props.name: applyLabel
props.description: Defaults to the `apply` label.

props.name: cancelLabel
props.description: Defaults to the `cancel` label.

props.name: clearLabel
props.description: Defaults to the `clear` label.

props.name: creatable
props.description: Offer a `Create "…"` row at the end of the list while the query matches no option exactly. `label` words the row (default: the `createOption` label, which also names it for screen readers).

props.name: onCreate
props.description: Makes the option for a query from the create row (trimmed). Return it, or a promise of it: the row shows a Spinner until it settles, and a rejection (or a throw) shows the `createFailed` label under the row. The option is added to the list and picked; it stays while the Combobox is mounted, so add it to `options` to keep it. Left out, the option is `{ value: query, label: query }`.

props.name: container
props.description: Portal target. Defaults to `document.body`.

props.name: onOpenAutoFocus
props.description: Keep focus where it is when the panel opens (inline previews).

props.name: onInteractOutside
props.description: A press outside the panel; `preventDefault()` keeps it open.
